chapters.label: Live: the 2014 final
chapters.text: The 2014 Futsal Euro final. Italy lead Russia, two to one. Eder Lima turns and shoots for the top corner. Mammarella flies up and tips it over the bar!

chapters.label: Replay: the fingertips
chapters.text: Watch again. His fingertips push the ball up and over. From that corner, Italy break and score. Three to one. Champions!

chapters.label: How a goleiro organises
chapters.text: A goleiro sees the whole court. So talk! Tell one defender to press, one to cover, and keep all four in front of you.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Talk to your defenders and keep them organised. Then you’re ready for the big save!
